engineering_interval.interpretation: fixed-corpus paired variation summary, not population inference

primary_decision_rule.insufficient_full_order_coverage: either candidate has less than 0.99 full-orderable coverage or fewer than 128 matched units have primary support
primary_decision_rule.insufficient_ordering_opportunities: either candidate has fewer than 500 complete-order choice-opportunity turns

analysis.primary_estimand: mean across matched start/color units of v4 minus v3 per-game mean normalised ordinal regret over full-orderable chosen-coarse-preserving candidate turns, with forced or oracle-tied turns contributing zero
secondary_metrics: coarse-WDL preservation and complete-order query coverage
best-grade selection conditional on a choice opportunity
mean normalised ordinal regret conditional on a choice opportunity
analysis.unit: one source record and one candidate color with paired retained-v3 and no-refresh-v4 completed games

definitions.full_order_choice_opportunity: the coarse-WDL-preserving legal set contains more than one distinct complete Malom ordering grade
definitions.normalised_ordinal_regret: zero for the best complete Malom ordering grade; otherwise the zero-based chosen distinct-grade rank divided by the number of worse-than-best rank steps, in [0,1]
definitions.within_wdl_orderable: the recorded choice preserves parent coarse W/D/L and every coarse-preserving legal action has a complete comparable OracleMoveValue

objective: Determine whether the named retained-v3 and no-refresh-v4 routes differ in complete Malom ordering alignment inside the coarse-WDL-preserving action set, after the safe-progress audit found essentially no missed preserving-capture selection mechanism.
